faqs.question: How does carbon offsetting work?
faqs.answer: When you book a stay, we automatically calculate the associated carbon footprint (transport, accommodation, activities). You can then choose to offset all or part of these emissions by funding certified environmental projects.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can cancel your reservation from your account. Cancellation terms vary by partner. Check the specific conditions at the time of booking for deadlines and any fees.

faqs.question: How do I contact a coworking space directly?
faqs.answer: Once your reservation is confirmed, you'll receive the establishment's full contact details by email. You can also find them in your account, under 'My reservations'.

faqs.question: Are donations tax-deductible?
faqs.answer: Yes, contributions to carbon offset projects qualify for a tax reduction. You automatically receive a tax receipt by email after each donation. The deduction rate depends on your country of residence.

faqs.question: How do I become a partner?
faqs.answer: If you manage an eco-responsible accommodation, coworking space or sustainable activity, you can apply from our 'Become a partner' page. Our team reviews each application against our sustainability criteria.
